intro.title: Meet the Box
paragraphs: The DongFeng Box redefines urban mobility with its bold, distinctive design and compact footprint. Perfect for city driving, this all-electric vehicle combines playful aesthetics with practical performance.
With a range that handles your daily commute and weekend adventures, the Box delivers everything you need in an eco-friendly package that stands out from the crowd.

features.title: Crystal LED Headlights
features.description: Precision-engineered LED headlights deliver exceptional visibility while adding a distinctive, modern aesthetic to the front profile.

features.title: Sleek Frameless Doors
features.description: Elegant frameless door design enhances the vehicle's aerodynamic profile while providing a premium, sophisticated entry experience.

features.title: Custom Sport Rims
features.description: Lightweight alloy sport rims combine stunning visual appeal with optimized aerodynamics for improved range and performance.

features.title: Flush Door Handles
features.description: Seamlessly integrated flush door handles sit perfectly level with the body, reducing drag while adding a sleek, modern touch to the exterior design.

sections.title: Find Your Perfect Colour
sections.subtitle: Select from a range of stunning colours to match your style.

features.title: Wireless Phone Charger
features.description: Conveniently charge your compatible smartphone without cables using the integrated wireless charging pad.

features.title: Designer Smart Key
features.description: A beautifully crafted smart key that combines elegant design with seamless keyless entry and start functionality.

features.title: Fast Charging
features.description: Get back on the road quickly with ultra-fast charging capability that minimizes downtime on longer journeys.

features.title: Mood Memory
features.description: Your perfect environment, remembered. Save personalised settings for climate, seat position, music, ambient lighting and windshield defrosting that restore automatically each time you drive.

sections.title: Safety First
sections.subtitle: Your protection is our priority. The Box is equipped with advanced safety features.

features.title: Adaptive Cruise Control
features.description: Automatically adjusts your speed to maintain a safe distance from the vehicle ahead, making highway driving effortless and safe.

features.title: Intelligent Brake Assist
features.description: Detects emergency braking situations and applies maximum braking force to help reduce stopping distance and avoid collisions.

features.title: Lane Departure Warning
features.description: Monitors lane markings and alerts you when the vehicle begins to drift out of its lane without signaling.

features.title: Comfy Eco Friendly Cabin
features.description: Sustainable materials meet premium comfort in a thoughtfully designed cabin that's as kind to the environment as it is to passengers.

features.title: Multifunction Steering Wheel
features.description: Keep your hands on the wheel and eyes on the road with intuitive controls for audio, phone, and driver assistance features.

features.title: Smart Discreet Storage
features.description: Clever storage solutions throughout the cabin keep your essentials organized and within easy reach while maintaining a clean aesthetic.

features.title: One Touch Seat Reclining
features.description: Effortlessly adjust your seating position with one-touch reclining controls, making it easy to find your perfect driving posture or relax during charging stops.

features.title: Spacious Back Seats
features.description: Generous rear legroom and thoughtful ergonomics ensure passengers in the back enjoy the same level of comfort as those up front.

variantComparison.title: Compare Variants
variantComparison.subtitle: See how each Box variant stacks up to find the perfect fit for your lifestyle.

cta.title: Experience the Box for Yourself
cta.subtitle: Ready to see what makes the Box special? Book a test drive today and discover the joy of electric driving.

modal.subtitle: Experience the Box for yourself. Fill in your details and we'll be in touch.
